correctness.rationale: For target state \(t\), reversing a reset word gives a rotating infection set whose first appearances follow a forced predecessor chain. Its \(n-1\) effective merge events require at least \(t+(n-2)(n-1)\) rotations, giving a sharp bound \(L_n+t\). At one letter of slack the extra inverse merge cannot remove a vertex; classifying its neutral phase yields exactly two boundary extensions, \(n-1\) doubled merges, and \((n-2)(n-3)\) internal split positions. The standalone verifier compares exact forward-subset counts for \(n=2,\ldots,13\) and exhaustive literal sets for \(n=2,\ldots,8\). No infinite conclusion is inferred from finite enumeration.
